blogPosts.title: EXTRA-LONG HANDMADE NAIL LUXURY
paragraphs: Some nails are just an accessory. Others are wearable art. The X-ON Signature Collection belongs firmly to the second category — an extra-long, handmade luxury nail line designed to stay ahead of the market, in exclusive shapes and designs you will only find at X-ON.
Every design is hand-crafted by our artists, down to the smallest detail. Here is what is inside the collection:
The entire Signature Collection is built on professional gel and premium acrylic powder — the two materials responsible for durability, flexibility, and a natural fit against your real nail.

A premium high-gloss top coat locks in true color, resists scratching, and holds its shine. Every crystal, foil detail, and 3D charm is hand-set and built to stay put. That is how an X-ON set can look like it just walked out of America’s best salon — while you wear it at home.

Handmade nails are not rare in the U.S. market — but most stop at safe, easy-to-mass-produce designs. X-ON goes the other direction: every design in the Signature Collection is exclusive and one-of-a-kind, developed by our team ahead of the trend curve rather than in response to it.
We believe X-ON’s designs lead the U.S. market in creativity, detail, and finish quality — and that is something our customers will not find anywhere else.
AT THE SALON: ~2 HRS in the chair, for a cost of up to
WITH X-ON: ~15 MIN at home, at a fraction of the cost
The same standout look — sometimes even more detailed and unique — thanks to Cold Gel Glue’s no-UV, no-filing, no-lamp application. The quality still matches a top U.S. salon.

blogPosts.title: SALON-QUALITY HANDMADE NAILS, REIMAGINED FOR HOME
paragraphs: Most press-on nails are mass-produced: molded in plastic, stamped with pre-printed designs. Convenient, sure — but look closely and they tend to read flat, uneven in thickness, and prone to snapping. That rigid, off-the-shelf material cannot hug the natural curve of your nail, so it lifts early, wears out fast, and never quite feels comfortable.

X-ON takes the opposite approach. Every set is hand-crafted, nail by nail, using professional-grade gel and premium acrylic powder — for a look that is realistic, refined, and genuinely salon-caliber. That is the difference between an assembly-line product and a piece made by hand.
The X-ON signature — our best-selling nail system.

We obsess over quality and detail so every customer gets a salon-level manicure experience without leaving the house. Ready to ship from our U.S. stock — order today, and it can be on its way tomorrow.
Our next-generation nail adhesive, exclusive to X-ON.
Paired with Grip-X Nails is Cold Gel Glue, X-ON proprietary adhesive built specifically for handmade nail sets — the piece that makes at-home application fast, safe, and salon-durable.
✦ Pro tip: apply a small amount and press firmly for about 20 seconds for the strongest bond.
Our collections track today’s biggest trends — from elegant nudes and cat-eye finishes to chrome and 3D nail art, plus our elevated handmade luxury sets.
Sizing: S, M, L (true to U.S. sizing) • Length: short, medium, long • Shape: a wide range of options for every hand.

blogPosts.title: How to Have Beautiful Nails in Less Than 10 Minutes
paragraphs: Learn the 4 easy steps to apply your X-ON Grip-X nails for 3-4 week wear.
Step 1: Prep your natural nails by gently pushing back cuticles and lightly buffing the nail surface.
Step 2: Wipe clean with an alcohol pad to remove dust and oils.
Step 3: Apply a small drop of Cold Gel Glue to the base of the Grip-X nail.
Step 4: Press firmly onto your natural nail at a 45-degree angle and hold for 20 seconds. Repeat for all nails!
